# Evidence block supplied by the PI (may be used in the edit)

- Preliminary data: retrospective cohort at Site A, 18,240 adults with CKD stages 3–4, 2015–2022.
  Gradient-boosted model predicted rapid eGFR decline (≥5 mL/min/1.73 m² per year) with AUROC 0.81
  (95% CI 0.79–0.83) versus 0.72 (95% CI 0.70–0.74) for the KFRE-based baseline. Figure 1.
- Rapid decliners in the cohort: 2,190 (12.0%).
- Collaborator: Site B nephrology department has agreed to provide de-identified EHR data for external
  validation (letter of support from the Site B department chair attached).
- PI record: two prior first-author papers on CKD progression modeling. No prior NIH R01 funding.
